mapper.select: select id from documents where id=#{id} and type='SUPPLIER' and approval_status='APPROVED' and deleted='0' for update
select coalesce(max(version),0) from supplier_profile_version where supplier_id=#{id}
mapper.update: update documents set revision=revision+1,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and approval_status='APPROVED' and deleted='0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from review_cases where type='SUPPLIER_CHANGE' and target_id=#{id} and sensitive=true and status='IN_REVIEW'
mapper.update: update payment_account_snapshot set confirmed=false,updated_at=now() where supplier_id=#{id} and payment_id in(select id from payments where status not in('PAID','APPROVED','VOID'))

update payments set status='IN_REVIEW',current_node='FINANCE_REVIEW',revision=revision+1,review_comment=null,director_comment=null,update_time=now() where supplier_id=#{id} and deleted='0' and status in('IN_REVIEW','READY_TO_PAY')
mapper.insert: insert into payment_account_snapshot values(#{paymentId},#{supplierId},#{version},#{snapshot},true,now()) on duplicate key update supplier_id=#{supplierId},profile_version=#{version},snapshot=#{snapshot},confirmed=true,updated_at=now()
mapper.select: select profile_version as version,snapshot,confirmed,updated_at as updatedAt from payment_account_snapshot where payment_id=#{paymentId}
select version,snapshot,cast(case_id as char) as caseId,created_at as createdAt from supplier_profile_version where supplier_id=#{id} order by version desc
select cast(id as char) as id,number,status,amount_cents as amountCents from payments where supplier_id=#{id} and deleted='0' and status not in('PAID','APPROVED','VOID') order by create_time desc
